title: Cash to Bank
desc: Move unsecure cash into a bank checking account.
to-teach: Transfer physical cash to a bank account.
hints: Unsecured cash cannot pay electronic bills and risks loss.
Open a checking account and transfer your physical cash balance into it.

client.name: Sam
client.description: Sam keeps all earnings in physical cash, making bill payments risky and leaving cash vulnerable.
client.prompt: I keep all my money in paper cash at home, but I need to pay my internet bill electronically. How do I secure this?
